articles.title: Landlords seek ‘one off payments’ to beat Renters Rights Act – claim
articles.summary: The claim is made in an online blog
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords are advocating for "one-off payments" as a strategy to navigate the upcoming Renters Rights Act, according to an online blog.  
- This approach highlights growing tensions between landlords and new rental regulations aimed at protecting tenant rights.

articles.title: Regaining possession already tougher thanks to S21 demise
articles.summary: Section 8 is now the only legal means of evictions for landlords
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords face increased challenges in regaining possession of rental properties following the abolition of Section 21 evictions.  
- Section 8 is now the sole legal route for landlords to initiate evictions, complicating the process significantly.

articles.title: Reform UK to resuscitate Right To Buy through more building
articles.summary: This is one of a series of housing pledges by Reform UK
articles.ai_summary:
- Reform UK is launching a plan to revive the Right to Buy initiative with a focus on increasing new housing construction.  
- This proposal is part of a broader set of housing commitments aimed at addressing the UK’s property market challenges.

articles.title: Most landlords keep faith with buy to let – optimistic survey data
articles.summary: The majority are not abandoning BTL despite recent tax and red tape changes
articles.ai_summary:
- Most landlords remain committed to buy-to-let investments, showing optimism despite recent tax and regulatory challenges.  
- Recent survey data indicates that the majority of landlords are not deterred by changes affecting the rental market.

articles.title: Landlord must pay thousands after neglecting historic building
articles.summary: There's been a clampdown in this city on neglected historic premises
articles.ai_summary:

- The city is intensifying efforts to tackle the issue of derelict historic sites, signaling a crackdown on landlords who let them fall into disrepair.

articles.title: Landlords particularly vulnerable for property fraud – claim

articles.title: Landlords urged to check for extreme heat damage

articles.ai_summary:
